segments.text: Section 2. You will listen to a human resource staff member giving a brief
introduction about a company to the interns. First you have some time to look
at questions 11 to 50. Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 50.
Good morning and welcome all to your company. My name is Billy Gray from the
HR department and today I would like to run through some policies that you must
know during your time here. First, working hours. Unlike official staff whose working hours are from
9 to 5, interns can come one hour later and leave one hour earlier. However, since I started working
here, I've seen no interns follow the 10 to 4 working hours as they want to spend more time
getting familiar with their jobs and earning as much experience as possible.
Hunger for work practice is good but remember that the company policies do not allow interns
to work overtime. Despite that you can get to the office 30 minutes earlier than normal working time
to prepare for your day. Now it's fine if you want to take some days off to care for your personal
business. If it is a planned leave, you are required to send a leave form to the HR department
at least two days in advance. If it is an emergency, inform directly to your supervisor
in person or via phone call. However, you still have to complete a form when you get back to work.
Some of you have already asked me about dress code. As you can see, we don't really have
a formal uniform here. You may wear casual clothes as long as they're practical.
The only restriction is on high heels for health and safety reasons.
Comfortable footwear like trainers is preferred. Talking about company facilities we have a state
of the art canteen which provides a wide variety of healthy meals with a low price for employees.
snacks and drinks are also available through a vending machine system in every
rest zone. Therefore we decided to apply a no outside food policy. This is partly
to encourage healthy eating at work and partly to stop people from eating at
their desk which is unhygienic. Those are some general policies you should
notice. If you have any questions about company procedures don't hesitate to
contact me. Each of you is also assigned a mentor who will provide help and
support through your internship, but remember your supervisor is the one you
report to, not your mentor. I've seen many interns having misunderstood their
mentor as their boss, so please don't make the same mistakes. You now have some
time to look at questions 16 to 20. Now listen carefully and answer questions 16
to 20. Our company has recently gone through an all-out renovation. Several
rooms across the building have been relocated, so I'm now going to mention
the location of some common places you might frequently go during your time
here. First, the canteen. Most of the big firms I know locate their canteen in
the basement because there's plenty of space down there. However, our CEO saw
importance of lunch to the productivity of staff, he decided to move the canteen
to the top floor. Enjoying a meal with a bird's-eye view, you don't often get
that experience on a daily basis. Each floor has its own meeting room and all
the biggest meetings and events of our company are hosted in the function room
which can hold up to 500 people. It is right next to the canteen so an event can
easily end with a lovely buffet. The next place I'd like to mention is a new
feature of the building. Starting from this year a library is available which
will be useful for you interns to do research and it is where the canteen was
previously located in the basement. There you can find all kinds of
documents and archives. So make sure to take advantage of this amazing new area.
Another new area I'm sure you will love is the napping room. A quick nap after
lunch is proved to boost productivity so the old function room in the basement has
been converted into a napping room. Just follow the sign and the canteen on the
top floor to find your way to your nap. Last but not least, the medical room. If
you ever find yourself in a situation where you need a doctor, go down to the
ground floor and you can see Dr. White's room just around the corner from the
elevator. We really do hope that you don't have to see him too much. Now let's
move on. That is the end of section 2. You now have 30 seconds to check your
answers to section 2. Now turn to section 3.
